fit_reason: Whole 1939 Buick Special sedan listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Dark blue paint along the driver side looks somewhat dull and flat in the sunlight rather than deep and glossy
Dust and grime on the engine bay surfaces, air cleaner and around the carburetor
Light dirt and wear marks on the front floor carpet around the pedals
Whitewall tires show some light discoloration that a cleaning would brighten
message: Hi John, we saw your listing for the 1939 Buick Special and it is a great looking original car. From the photos, the dark blue paint on the side looks like it could come up with more depth, and the engine bay and front carpet could use a careful cleaning. We do pre-sale details and gentle paint polishing and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
